crossRefs.note: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge…
“Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth…
You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly…

translations.web: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?
translations.bsb: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the LORD has not denounced?
translations.kjv: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
translations.asv: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? And how shall I defy, whom Jehovah hath not defied?
